hash_rules.files: SHA-256 of the complete raw file bytes
hash_rules.semantic_components: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, and compact separators
hash_rules.self_reference: This lock and tests/test_information_sufficiency_locks.py are intentionally not hashed by this lock.

value.projection: The complete candidate-only CitationExtractionProposal.v1 bundle is returned unchanged, including the source snapshot, page text, anchors, match fields, and selected match IDs.
value.equivalence: Both projected bundles must deeply equal the same baseline candidate bundle, not merely share a digest.

value.fixture_scope: Only the pinned lineage-silent PDF and exact extracted page text are accepted.
value.candidate_selection: Exactly two body-anchored occurrences and reference-anchored matches; selected match IDs cover both matches and their formally distinct target-identifier candidate strings.
value.anchor_binding: Body and reference anchors are exact page-text spans, with citation marker and complete target-identifier consistency checked by the frozen checker.
value.mapping_domain: Exactly the two target-identifier candidate strings, with no missing or extra key.
value.root_sets: Each target has a nonempty list of distinct nonempty primary-root labels.
value.reality_claim: Synthetic possible assignments only; target identifiers are formal candidates, not authenticated papers.

value.statement: The works hypothetically denoted by two selected bibliographic target candidates have disjoint primary evidence roots.
value.test: The two candidate-assigned primary-root sets are disjoint.
value.authority_limit: No authenticated paper identity, claim support, L2 qualification, current-use binding, or execution authorization.
